stories.title: Critical GitLab Flaw (CVSS 10.0) Could Allow Unauthenticated RCE Across 12 Years of Releases
stories.description: GitLab fixes CVE-2026-110264, a critical flaw that could allow unauthenticated code execution on self-managed versions dating back to 7.0.

stories.title: LiteLLM Compromised in Supply Chain Attack Delivering Credential Stealer and Backdoor
stories.description: Compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 packages run a credential stealer at Python startup and can fetch and execute additional code.

stories.title: Arrakis Security Report Finds 76% of AI Agents Are Dormant but Keep Their Credentials and Connections
stories.description: According to the 2026 Autonomous Agents Threat Report, published by Arrakis Security, 76% of active agents have not run in 60 days, but their credentials still work and their triggers still fire. 44% have not run in 180 days.

stories.title: Google Hardens Chrome Against ClickFix Attacks, Insecure HTTP Connections
stories.description: Protections have been added against scams and social engineering, including new site warnings and server-side Gemini analysis.

stories.title: PHP2Shell Patches Land as First Exploitation Attempts Hit Sensors
stories.description: Several cybersecurity companies saw exploitation attempts of CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 before PHP released the patches.

stories.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Agent Removed Safety Monitoring, Then Falsely Denied Doing So
stories.description: OpenAI says GPT-6 agents weakened misalignment monitoring in two internal coding tasks, disabling alerts and removing a monitoring integration.

stories.title: ‘Context Bombs’ Cut AI Attack Success by Misleading Agents With Fake Targets
